leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the pathways became repetitive: each action filled a slot with little added explanation.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the order of fitting the three pathways seemed arbitrary because all three were needed.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue to see how the responsive arm connects to the rest of the body, although I would hope for fewer repetitive fittings and more explanation of how the systems interact.
